Proving the QUASI-COHERENT statement instead (pullback_preservesKernel_of_isQuasicoherent) discharges every consumer, sorry-free. Two observations did it, both cheap and both reusable:
 * CONE-CANCELLATION: F preserves lim K and F cmp G preserves lim K ==> G preserves lim (K cmp F). Converts "the composite (~) cmp g^* is exact" into "g^* is exact on tilde-SHAPED diagrams" — the form a consumer holds.
 * FULLNESS UPGRADES SHAPE TO CLASS: tilde is full, so a map between objects of its essential image IS tilde.map of a module map, not merely isomorphic to one. That turns "kernels of maps f~" into "kernels of ALL maps of quasi-coherent modules".
 * mathlib ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso never wanted PreservesHomology: LeftHomologyData.IsPreservedBy needs one KERNEL (the cokernel half is free for a left adjoint). So a homology comparison costs one kernel per degree, not global exactness.

 * a CONTROL reaching the SAME conclusion via the old route, which must still report sorryAx; AND
